real_use_case: Validate complete paired FASTQ artifacts and their declared run before downstream processing.
upstream_status: Illumina bcl2fastq2 v2.20 Software Guide, document 15051736 v03, February 2019. The resource profile records the source URL, PDF SHA-256 and the supported restrictions.
license: Independent implementation and synthetic fixtures. Referenced Illumina documentation remains copyrighted by its publisher; no vendor code, documentation bytes or third-party fixtures are distributed.
supported_profile: resources/input-profiles/paired-fastq-illumina-non-umi-phred33-v1.json: two uncompressed ASCII streams, four-line records, non-UMI Illumina-style headers and declared PHRED33.
resource_budget: Engineering limits: 64 MiB per mate, 128 MiB combined, 100000 pairs, 1000 bases per read, 512 header-content bytes, 4096 bytes per physical line, 64 KiB per stream read, 4096-byte canonical declaration and 16 KiB result. Streaming qualification budget: 256 MiB RSS and 60 seconds.
output_contract: schemas/fastq-intake-result.v1.schema.json; FastqIntakeResult.is_valid and detached FastqIntakeResult.to_dict() export whole-artifact identities, pair count and explicit structural assessments.
known_issues: Restricted structural profile; no biological identity, encoding provenance inference, global duplicate detection, filtering, alignment, calling or scientific interpretation. Stream objects may share backing storage. Caller supplies any blocking-I/O deadline.
security: Bounded binary stream consumption with exact supplied-content hashes and sizes. Failure exports one fixed code and no accepted observations. Raw reads, headers, paths and exception text are excluded from results.
disable_path: Explicit omnigenis.capabilities.fastq_intake.validate_paired_fastq invocation only; no default pipeline or package-level export.
